```php
<?php

namespace App\Policies;

use App\Models\User;
use App\Models\Note;
use Illuminate\Auth\Access\HandlesAuthorization;

class NotePolicy implements HandlesAuthorization
{
    /**
     * Determine whether the user can view any models.
     *
     * @param  \App\Models\User  $user
     * @return bool
     */
    public function viewAny(User $user)
    {
        return true; // Allow all users to view notes
    }

    /**
     * Determine whether the user can view a model.
     *
     * @param  \App\Models\User  $user
     * @param  \App\Models\Note  $note
     * @return bool
     */
    public function view(User $user, Note $note)
    {
        return true; // Allow all users to view notes
    }

    /**
     * Determine whether the user can create models.
     *
     * @param  \App\Models\User  $user
     * @return bool
     */
    public function create(User $user)
    {
        return $user->can('create notes'); // Allow only users with specific permission to create notes
    }

    /**
     * Determine whether the user can update a model.
     *
     * @param  \App\Models\User  $user
     * @param  \App\Models\Note  $note
     * @return bool
     */
    public function update(User $user, Note $note)
    {
        return $user->can('update notes'); // Allow only users with specific permission to update notes
    }

    /**
     * Determine whether the user can delete a model.
     *
     * @param  \App\Models\User  $user
     * @param  \App\Models\Note  $note
     * @return bool
     */
    public function delete(User $user, Note $note)
    {
        return $user->can('delete notes'); // Allow only users with specific permission to delete notes
    }
}
```
